extended:
**Standard Relations of Multiple Polylogarithm Values at Roots of Unity**

*Jianqiang Zhao*

34 pp, 18 sections.

**Abstract.** Let N be a positive integer. In this paper we shall study the special values of multiple polylogarithms at Nth roots of unity, called multiple polylogarithm values (MPVs) of level N. Our primary goal in this paper is to investigate the relations among the MPVs of the same weight and level by using the regularized double shuﬄe relations, regularized distribution relations, lifted versions of such relations from lower weights, and weight one relations which are produced by relations of weight one MPVs. We call relations from the above four families standard. Let d(w, N) be the dimension of the Q-vector space generated by all MPVs of weight w and level N. Re- cently Deligne and Goncharov were able to obtain some lower bound of d(w, N) using the motivic mechanism. We call a level N standard if N = 1, 2, 3 or N = pn for prime p ≥5.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 1.1 Multiple polylog values at roots of unity; 1.2 Standard relations of MPVs; 1.3 Main results; 1.4 Acknowledgment; 2 The double shuffle relations and the algebra; 3 Weight one relations; 4 Regularized distribution relations; 5 Lifted relations from lower weights; 6 Some conjectures of FDS and RDS; 7 The structure of MPVs and some examples; 7.1 Weight one; 7.2 Weight two; 7.3 Weight three; 7.4 Upper bound of d(w, N) by Deligne and Gonc; 8 Computational results in weight two; 9 Computational results in weight three, four
